title: When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2610.36826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous agents increasingly depend on harnesses that govern interaction, memory, tools, and execution around large language models (LLMs). While recent work has begun to evolve these harnesses from execution experience, the supervision used to guide evolution often remains relatively static, making it difficult to track changing behavioral weaknesses across rounds and potentially limiting generalization to unseen tasks. To address this issue, we propose RuHarness, a rubric--harness co-evolution framework for continual agent self-improvement. RuHarness continually discovers and reassesses behavioral criteria from execution trajectories, prioritizes the most relevant unresolved weaknesses, and uses them to guide targeted harness updates while keeping the task objective fixed. translated_title: 当评判者落后时：评测标准与执行框架的协同进化以实现智能体的持续自我改进
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.36826v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：自主智能体越来越依赖于围绕大语言模型（LLM）构建的执行框架，用于管理交互、记忆、工具和执行。尽管近期的工作已开始从执行经验中进化这些框架，但用于指导进化的监督信号往往保持相对静态，这使得难以追踪跨轮次不断变化的行为弱点，并可能限制对未见任务的泛化能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 RuHarness，一个用于智能体持续自我改进的评测标准与执行框架协同进化框架。RuHarness 持续从执行轨迹中发现并重新评估行为准则，优先处理最相关的未解决弱点，并利用它们指导有针对性的框架更新，同时保持任务目标不变。在多样化智能体任务和多种骨干模型上的大量实验表明，RuHarness 优于强大的框架进化基线，尤其是在未见任务上表现突出。
tldr: 提出了 RuHarness 框架，通过评测标准与执行框架的协同进化，持续从执行轨迹中发现并更新行为准则以指导针对性框架改进，实现智能体的持续自我提升并显著增强对未见任务的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: RuHarness is a rubric-harness co-evolution framework that continually discovers and reassesses behavioral criteria from execution trajectories to guide targeted harness updates, enabling continual agent self-improvement and superior generalization to unseen tasks.
